'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matt Sokol DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sokol]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Watto Done Better
* '''Username:''' mr purple
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
